integrity: Proof and standalone finite exhaustive checker included; experimental checks do not certify infinite assertions. Closest source examined in full. Older nilpotent-element primary full texts not secured.
scientific_limitations: Counts actual embedded monogenic inverse submonoids containing the ambient identity of the symmetric inverse monoid. Does not count ordinary power-generated subsemigroups, conjugacy classes, or arbitrary inverse submonoids. Raw nilpotent element counts and asymptotic coefficient methods are preexisting background; the embedding census and its submonoid-level nilpotent ratio are the assessed contribution. Independent audit and global publication priority checks are not performed.
title: Embedded monogenic inverse submonoids: exact census and a square-root nilpotent law
